messages.content: How do I report a lost card?

response:
According to our public FAQ, if you've lost your debit or credit card, please contact us immediately so we can assist with canceling the card and issuing a replacement.

To report a lost card, you can:

1. Call our 24/7 customer service number at 0800-123456.
2. Visit any of our branches in person.
3. Use our mobile banking app to report the issue online.

We'll guide you through the process of canceling your card and issuing a new one as soon as possible.
